description_en: Sends a verification code to a secure phone number when you set the secure phone number for a member of the resource account type by calling SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone
description_zh: 为资源账号类型的成员设置安全手机号码时，调用SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone向安全手机发送验证码
name: SendVerificationCodeForBindSecureMobilePhone

parameters.help_en:
The secure phone number.

Format: <Country code>-<Phone number>.

<props="china">
Only phone numbers in the Chinese mainland in the format of `86-<Phone number>` are supported.</props>


<props="intl">
Phone numbers in the Chinese mainland in the format of `86-<Phone number>` are not supported.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
安全手机号码。

格式：<国家码>-<手机号码>。

<props="china">
仅支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>


<props="intl">
不支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>
parameters.name: secure_mobile_phone

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the member
parameters.name: account_id

ExpirationDate.description_en: The expiration time of the verification code. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, indicated by Z for UTC
ExpirationDate.description_zh: 验证码过期时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC
